description: Character progression (docs/progression-roadmap.md). Stage 1: kill XP into Skyrim's character level. Stages 2-3: weapon proficiencies per gun type and manufacturer (Prof keys). The Borderlands 2 numbers were read from the user's progression surveys (bl2-progress-report.txt and bl2-progress-deep-report.txt; the rule: BL2 file values replace static values); the pace (kills per level) and the caps are Skylands choices. The plugin reads the values from SkylandsNative.ini (skse.progression_ini).

columns.value: the default written to the ini
columns.source: bl2 = read from Borderlands 2; design = a Skylands choice
columns.bl2_object: the Borderlands 2 object the number comes from ('-' when none)
